parse.title: Stringy
parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 16 - Overlord Update

Overview

Stringy is a Secret Limited unit. He can only be obtained via completing String Portal (guaranteed if you are the host).

Evolving

Stringy can evolve into Stringy (Awakened) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Stringy
x40 SMILE Fruit
x12 Star Fruit
x4 Star Fruit (Blue)
x4 Star Fruit (Red)
x4 Star Fruit (Green)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)

(Awakened)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 7,500 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
